import torch

def tensor_stats(name, p):
    p = p.detach().float()
    if p.dim() != 2:
        return
    rn = p.norm(dim=1)
    med = rn.median().item()
    p90 = rn.kthvalue(int(rn.numel()*0.9)).values.item() if rn.numel()>1 else med
    p99 = rn.kthvalue(int(rn.numel()*0.99)).values.item() if rn.numel()>3 else med
    maxv, maxi = rn.max(0)
    ratio = maxv/med if med>0 else float('inf')
    # rows > med*5
    rows_high = (rn > med*5).nonzero(as_tuple=False).flatten().tolist()
    rows_high = sorted(rows_high, key=lambda i: -rn[i].item())
    # top 5 rows with norms
    topk = min(5, rn.numel())
    top_vals, top_idx = torch.topk(rn, topk)
    top_info = [(int(i), float(v)) for i,v in zip(top_idx, top_vals)]
    return {
        'name': name,
        'shape': tuple(p.shape),
        'med': med,
        'p90': p90,
        'p99': p99,
        'max': maxv.item(),
        'max_row': maxi.item(),
